summary: Tested new named/criteria-based Hedef Kitle (Audiences) feature end-to-end (backend + frontend) and admin category card icons. All 7 backend tests passed (seed list of 3, CRUD, preview semantics 4/8 for İstanbul-Direktör, feed regression for announcements/events). Frontend: Kategori Yönetimi cards (7 active) and Yakında cards (8) all render icons. AudiencePicker inside cat-edit dialog exposes select+new; selecting seeded audience updates 'Hedef: <name>'. Builder opens with all data-testids present, criteria editor works, preview toast shows '4/8 çalışan eşleşiyor', save persists and picker reflects the new audience name. Cleanup DELETE succeeded (200).
critical_code_review_comments: AudiencePicker.js: onSelect ignores '__custom__' — fine, but selectedKey defaults to '__custom__' when a stored audience lacks an id (legacy shape), which could show 'Özel Seçim (...)'. Consider hiding when value is empty object.
server.py employee_matches: when includes list is empty and excludes exist, treats as match-all-minus-excludes; documented behavior — confirm intended.
AudienceBuilder Select for 'Mevcut Tanımdan Kopyala' is uncontrolled and doesn't reset between opens; low priority.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_QA_Audience (deleted) via API, TEST_QA_UI_Audience (deleted) via UI+API cleanup
context_for_next_testing_agent: AudiencePicker + AudienceBuilder verified against category (cat-seg-*) prefix. Other prefixes (event-seg, pulse-seg, ann-seg, sub-seg, concept-seg, listing-seg, mood-seg) use the same shared component — considered covered by cat-seg verification unless a specific issue arises. Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_audiences.py.
